## Equal vectors, equal components {#iv2-equality .component-lesson .vector-lesson}

Two vectors are equal if and only if their corresponding components are equal.

<div data-components="equality"></div>

::: takeaway
Translation changes where the arrow is drawn. Its components stay the same.
:::
<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 19</div>

::: notes
This makes explicit the connection to the opening translation activity. The copy is (3,2) at every location. Compare like components, rather than treating i and j as unknown real numbers that can cancel each other. Mutually perpendicular directions are independent.
:::
